_comment: AW-6 mechanical risk-path check. path_patterns are glob patterns matched against edited file paths; import_patterns are literal substrings matched against edited file content (e.g. an import line), per named high-risk area (TS-17). Empty per-area lists are expected until the matching app code exists beyond draft/ — add patterns as slices are built, review whenever a new high-risk area is named. Area set revised 2026-09-19: fractional-order-calculation retired (fractional ordering no longer exists in the data model); data-invariant-transactions added (ADR-007).

auth-allowlist.description: Cognito claim extraction, Map membership checks, read-authorization (visibility) decisions, handle-claim ownership checks, any write-authorization path. (Key name kept for stability — there is no allowlist; authorization is membership plus visibility.)

cross-slice-authorization.description: Any code that resolves or checks a Node/content item's owning top-level Map across slice boundaries — id parsing and root-Map derivation, and the order in which read/write authorization runs relative to loading content.

data-invariant-transactions.description: Multi-item DynamoDB transactions that maintain counters, derived fields (childCount, imageCount, hasArticle, excerpt), uniqueness claims (handles, link pairs) and content exclusivity — first-login provisioning, Node/Link/View create and delete, Map cascade delete (ADR-007). The repository layer is the only place allowed to write derived fields.
